externalDocs.description: Legislative Council Bills Database data dictionary

info.description:
The source documentation provides a field dictionary for bill records, but does not document an HTTP operation, request parameters, authentication, or a response envelope. The catalogue associates the dataset with the literal read-only resource URL https://app.legco.gov.hk/BillsDB/odata/Vbills and provides downloadable JSON and XML resources, but explicitly warns that these associations do not establish an API contract. No executable HTTP operation is specified here. The version value is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version.

This maintained derivative additionally exposes exact catalogue-published read-only retrieval links with their native formats and selector combinations. The publisher field dictionary remains contextual when the complete response envelope is unspecified.
info.title: Legislative Council Bills Database

get.description: Read-only retrieval of exact publisher-listed resources, beginning with https://app.legco.gov.hk/BillsDB/odata/Vbills?$format=json&$inlinecount=allpages&$filter=bill_gazette_date+ge+datetime%271997-07-01%27+and+bill_gazette_date+lt+datetime%271998-07-01%27. The complete evidenced URLs and native formats are retained in x-published-resource-requests; only their recorded selector combinations are evidenced. These are published retrieval links; no additional hosted API or URL template is asserted. Dictionary components describe contextual record fields without establishing the complete payload shape. Authentication is unspecified. The JSON response envelope and eight nullable date alternatives are observations from one complete retained response, separate from the PDF-defined record fields. Other selector results and XML payload structure remain unassessed.
